evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented contrast appeals to self-origination (owning vs. renting your intelligence) and to standing/achievement (ownership as a value beyond mere use).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (your own perspective as durable possession) and to mastery/craft (the perspective itself as the valuable capability).

mints.name: OwnershipAsValueAxis
mints.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to ownership — keeping, holding, owning — as the good that distinguishes self-origination from dependence?
